desc: Ideate the ternary-tree majority DP and identify the one-state flip-cost recurrence.
Implement the complete Python solution using the one-state flip-cost DP with in-place level compression and robust byte-level input parsing.
Verify the solution on the sample inputs and confirm correctness/performance for N=13.
Cross-check with the two-state cost-to-0/cost-to-1 DP if needed (not needed; one-state DP passed samples).
